$comment: Written by hand, not generated. Its bounds are the server's (server/builder/releases.py TITLE_MAX, NOTES_MAX, HIGHLIGHTS_MAX, HIGHLIGHT_MAX) and capture/tests/test_releases.py holds them there. Handed to `claude -p --json-schema` by capture/releases/draft.py.
title: ReleaseDraft
description: The draft of a release note about a project, which its builder reads, edits and publishes from the phone. Every sentence describes work that is in the input. A title with a number the input does not contain, written the same way, gets the whole answer thrown away; a sentence or a highlight with one is deleted. Plain words, no dashes.

title.description: What this release is about, in a few plain words. No number the input does not have, no repository or file name, no dash, no full stop at the end. (max 80 chars)

notes.description: Two to four short plain sentences: what changed and why it matters to somebody using it. Every number must be one the input gives, written the same way. No dash of any kind. (max 1200 chars)

highlights.description: Up to five, each one thing that changed, rewritten from the commits or the session record as a plain sentence a person would say. Capital first letter, no full stop at the end, no dash. (each max 120 chars, max 5 items)
